title: image/common.sh still names omp as the container's last-resort harness default
body: cloud/sandbox (vendored here at image/, pin d5dbfbc4) has `harness="${TICKS_HARNESS:-omp}"` — the one remaining layer whose built-in default names omp. It is unreachable in practice once the control plane always sets TICKS_HARNESS (workers via WORKER_DEFAULT_HARNESS, orchestrators via the RUN_HARNESS pin), but 'every layer that has one' arguably includes it, and image/ may only be changed in ticks. A one-line default change to pi (or to a refusal) in ticks, then moving sandbox.pin.json's ref here, would close it.
